detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for packages or build scripts that access sensitive files or environment variables and make outbound network requests, especially during installation, import, or CI/CD execution. Use static and dynamic analysis to flag code that exfiltrates data or contains hardcoded external endpoints. Audit package and build script changes for unauthorized modifications. Implement allowlists for trusted domains and flag any network communication to unrecognized endpoints during sensitive phases.
